title: rolter · dashboard UX
description: What the dashboard's own browser tracing sees: which API calls the SPA makes, which fail, and how slow they are. This is the view that surfaced the /me/* 401s in #942 — a screen returning 401 while every route beside it returns 200 is obvious here and invisible in the UI. Imported by `just dogfood` (#956).

widgets.title: Failing API calls by path
widgets.description: Every non-2xx the dashboard received, grouped by path and status. Path is stripped of its origin so the same call groups across localhost and the portless alias.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toString(attributes_number['http.response.status_code']) AS status, attributes_string['http.request.method'] AS method, replaceRegexpOne(attributes_string['url.full'], 'https?://[^/]+', '') AS path, count() AS calls, toString(max(timestamp)) AS last_seen FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE timestamp >= {{.start_datetime}} AND timestamp <= {{.end_datetime}} AND serviceName = 'rolter-ui' AND attributes_number['http.response.status_code'] >= 400 GROUP BY status, method, path ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 30

widgets.title: Dashboard API responses by status
widgets.description: A wall of 401s appearing while 200s continue is the signature of one route family rejecting a session the rest accepts.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, toString(attributes_number['http.response.status_code']) AS status, count() AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE timestamp >= {{.start_datetime}} AND timestamp <= {{.end_datetime}} AND serviceName = 'rolter-ui' AND attributes_number['http.response.status_code'] > 0 GROUP BY ts, status ORDER BY ts

widgets.title: Slowest dashboard API calls (p95)
widgets.description: Which screens are waiting on the control plane.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT replaceRegexpOne(attributes_string['url.full'], 'https?://[^/]+', '') AS path, count() AS calls, round(quantile(0.95)(durationNano) / 1e6, 1) AS p95_ms, round(max(durationNano) / 1e6, 1) AS max_ms FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE timestamp >= {{.start_datetime}} AND timestamp <= {{.end_datetime}} AND serviceName = 'rolter-ui' AND attributes_string['url.full'] != '' GROUP BY path ORDER BY p95_ms DESC LIMIT 20

widgets.title: Playground traffic through the gateway
widgets.description: Calls the dashboard made to /gw/v1/* — the Playground's own requests, separated from control-plane CRUD.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, if(attributes_number['http.response.status_code'] >= 400, concat('failed ', toString(attributes_number['http.response.status_code'])), 'ok') AS outcome, count() AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE timestamp >= {{.start_datetime}} AND timestamp <= {{.end_datetime}} AND serviceName = 'rolter-ui' AND position(attributes_string['url.full'], '/gw/v1/') > 0 GROUP BY ts, outcome ORDER BY ts
